FAMILY 14 · 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性2D-to-3D & Neural Fields

MedNeRF

MedNeRF 把 NeRF 置于 GAN 式跨病例生成先验中，以 shape/appearance latent 从单 X-ray 合成视角，而非逐场景多视图优化。

Adapts GIRAFFE/GRAF 3D-aware generative radiance fields to X-ray projections, disentangling 3D shape and appearance latents to synthesize continuous-angle CT projections from a single X-ray.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 训练时为未配对的 2D X-ray 与采样相机位姿；推理时以单张 X-ray 约束患者潜变量 Unpaired 2D DRR/X-ray projections during GAN training; a single 2D X-ray during test-time latent inversion
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 视角可控的 3D-aware CT projection 合成 Continuous-angle 3D-aware X-ray projection synthesis across 360° viewpoints
PRIMARY FIGURE // Figures 1 and 2 · PDF pp.2–3

SOURCE PDF
COMPUTATION GRAPH // 8 STAGES

架构前向计算节点拆解 Forward Pass Computation Nodes

STAGE 01 / 08 · 2D X-ray distribution2D X-ray distribution 以真实投影训练，无需每例 3D CT ground truth Ingests unpaired 2d drr/x-ray projections during gan training; a single 2d x-ray during test-time latent inversion and prepares initial tensor representations (2D X-ray distribution).
  1. 01
    2D X-ray distribution以真实投影训练，无需每例 3D CT ground truthIngests unpaired 2d drr/x-ray projections during gan training; a single 2d x-ray during test-time latent inversion and prepares initial tensor representations (2D X-ray distribution).
  2. 02
    Shape/appearance latents解耦患者解剖形态与投影外观/体深信息Executes Shape/appearance latents to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.
  3. 03
    Camera pose指定目标投影视角和射线Performs Camera pose within the core generative latent conditioned xray nerf computation pathway.
  4. 04
    Conditional radiance/density MLP以 3D 点、方向和潜变量预测连续体密度与辐射/强度Performs Conditional radiance/density MLP within the core generative latent conditioned xray nerf computation pathway.
  5. 05
    Differentiable ray integration沿每条射线积分得到 X-ray-like 2D projectionPerforms Differentiable ray integration within the core generative latent conditioned xray nerf computation pathway.
  6. 06
    2D adversarial discriminator区分合成与真实 X-ray，推动未配对生成训练Performs 2D adversarial discriminator within the core generative latent conditioned xray nerf computation pathway.
  7. 07
    Single-X-ray latent fitting以观测投影反求/优化匹配的患者 latent，再改变 poseApplies Single-X-ray latent fitting to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.
  8. 08
    3D-aware projections从单 X-ray 条件生成不同视角 CT 投影Produces continuous-angle 3d-aware x-ray projection synthesis across 360° viewpoints via 3D-aware projections.
MATHEMATICAL FORMALISM
核心公式 · 形状—外观潜变量解耦的单 X 线三维反演
Core Formalism · Generative Shape–Appearance Latent Conditioning & Test-Time Latent Inversion from a Single X-Ray
01 // PRIOR LIMITATION
上一代瓶颈

单视图到 3D 高度欠定，原始 NeRF 依赖多视图且建模可见光

Single-view X-ray to 3D reconstruction lacked multi-view supervision, while 2D GANs could not enforce 3D viewpoint consistency.

02 // CORE HYPOTHESIS
核心想法

以 GAN 条件先验和 NeRF 式场表示从单张 X-ray 生成视角可控的 CT 投影

Train a 3D-aware conditional generative radiance field on 2D X-ray projections with a multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator, then invert latent codes (z_s, z_a) from a single test X-ray.

03 // ARCHITECTURAL DELTA
关键改进

学习跨病例生成先验并引入医学投影数据生成新视角

Disentangled shape/appearance conditioning + volumetric feature rendering + test-time latent + generator fine-tuning.

04 // MEDICAL TRANSLATION
医学适配

直接任务是单 X-ray 的 3D-aware projection synthesis；数据增强与表示学习属于潜在用途

Explored for single-view chest and knee X-ray 3D-aware view synthesis and data augmentation.

05 // EVIDENCE & BOUNDARY
适用范围与证据

概念性医学 NeRF；生成投影不等价于患者真实 3D 解剖重建

Conceptual proof-of-concept; synthesized projections reflect a population GAN prior rather than guaranteed patient-specific 3D tomography.

ARCHITECTURAL AXIOMS // 设计原理与数学机制
  • 用连续 NeRF 场表示体内外解剖结构及投影视角变化。
  • 形状与外观/深度潜变量为生成器提供跨患者先验。
  • 以 2D 对抗学习训练投影分布，再从单张 X-ray 约束患者 latent 做新视角合成。
  • Core Hypothesis: Train a 3D-aware conditional generative radiance field on 2D X-ray projections with a multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator, then invert latent codes (z_s, z_a) from a single test X-ray.
  • Architectural Delta: Disentangled shape/appearance conditioning + volumetric feature rendering + test-time latent + generator fine-tuning.
  • Mathematical Formalism: Generative Shape–Appearance Latent Conditioning & Test-Time Latent Inversion from a Single X-Ray.
CLINICAL TRANSLATION & BOUNDARIES // 医学应用与安全边界
  • 直接任务是单 X-ray 的 3D-aware projection synthesis，可用于视角数据增强研究。
  • 单投影对应无限多 3D 解，未见结构主要来自生成先验；不能把合成视角当作真实 CT 或诊断重建。
  • Clinical Translation: Explored for single-view chest and knee X-ray 3D-aware view synthesis and data augmentation.
  • Evidence & Safety Boundary: Conceptual proof-of-concept; synthesized projections reflect a population GAN prior rather than guaranteed patient-specific 3D tomography.
PRIMARY LITERATURE // 原始文献 MedNeRF: Medical Neural Radiance Fields for Reconstructing 3D-Aware CT-Projections from a Single X-Ray
